{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Al Hidd Power and Water Station''' (محطة الحد لإنتاج الكهرباء) is an operating power station of at least 987-megawatts (MW) in Al Hidd, Muharraq, Bahrain.
It is also known as Al-Hidd IWPP, Al Hidd power plant.
